findings.title: Efficacy and safety of retatrutide in people with type 2 diabetes and inadequate glycaemic control with diet and exercise (TRANSCEND-T2D-1): phase 3 (Lancet)
findings.whatChanged: FIRST PUBLISHED PHASE 3 RESULT. Dossier regulatoryStatus says only "Phase 3 programme in obesity and type 2 diabetes (Eli Lilly)" with no published phase 3 data. TREATMENT-REGIMEN estimand HbA1c change -1.69% (4 mg), -1.86% (9 mg), -1.94% (12 mg) vs -0.81% placebo at week 40; n=537. DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(26)00967-0, NCT06354660.
